_comment: Numbers that no list stands behind: reviews done and proposals written.
The rule (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-27-cv-site-ssot-design.md): a number is either
typed alone, when no list of the counted things exists anywhere, or counted from a list.
Never both. So the counts that DO have a list are not here any more:
All three are derived by scripts/lib/derive.js and cited as `derived.<key>`.
Read by scripts/emit-metrics-tex.js (CV macros), scripts/build-site-json.js (the site's
stats cards), and citable from an application as `service.<key>`.
Update these by hand when the numbers change. Nothing will do it for you.
_comment_proposals: Proposals WRITTEN, not proposals funded. The funded total is derived from
data/awards.json. Keeping the two apart is the point: 'led 8 proposals' and 'one is
funded' are different claims and a cover letter must not let the first imply the second.
